topology_reasoning.evidence: The binary silhouette has two separated access guides on both left and right, each guide widening linearly toward the center. From x about 10.0 um to 15.5 um the material spans the full 2.5 um footprint height, forming a short multimode body. The shape is mirror symmetric about both x and y axes.
topology_reasoning.operation: Two input/output single-mode guides expand into the shared multimode slab where modal beating/coupling occurs, then taper back out to two separated output guides.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitive MMI model: full-height rectangle body, four linear access tapers ending at 1.25 um. Diff/metrics showed all target material covered but excess material in access taper gaps.
Reduced taper terminal widths from 1.25 um to 0.98 um to match measured access taper width immediately before the abrupt full-height MMI body.
